Spells:
Bull's Strength (D2 Tran): Touched gains +4 Strength for 5 min
Detect Animals Or Plants (D1 Divi): 600' cone reveals the presence and condition of a chosen kind of animal or plant for concentration up to 50 min; can change the chosen kind each rd
Detect Magic (D0 Divi): 60' cone reveals the presence, power, and schools of magical auras for concentration up to 5 min
Detect Poison (D0 Divi): R35' Reveals the presence of poison in the target; a successful DC 20 Wisdom or Craft (Alchemy) check reveals the type
Flare (D0 Evoc): R35' Dazzles the target (save Fortitude negates) for 1 min
Know Direction (D0 Divi): Reveals the direction of north
Produce Flame (D1 Evoc): Produces a torch flame in self hand for 5 min; can be used repeatedly for a ranged touch attack that inflicts 1d6+5 HP fire, reducing the duration by 1 min for each attack
Resistance (D0 Abju): Touched gains +1 saves for 1 min
Shillelagh (D1 Tran): Touched small, medium, or large staff gains +1 attack and inflicts 1d8+1 HP, 2d6+1 HP, or 3d6+1 HP (save Will negates) when wielded by self for 5 min
Wood Shape (D2 Tran): Reshapes a 15 cubic feet piece of wood (save Will negates)

Wisdom Druid Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level D1, D2
Natural Spell: Can cast spells during Wild Shape
Spontaneous Casting (Druid): Can cast Summon Nature's Ally spells in place of prepared spells
Wild Shape: Can change into a small to medium animal with up to 5 Hit Dice for 5 hr 1 time per day
